test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

My sister requested me to bring her a watch.

options.text: “Please bring my sister a watch,” said she.
“Please bring me a watch,” said my sister.
She said, “My sister, please bring me a watch.”
My sister said, “Will you bring me a watch?”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** My sister requested me to bring her a watch.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"requested me" becomes "Please"**
 
 
• Change the reporting verb "requested" to "please" for a direct request.
 
 
 
• **"her" becomes "me"**
 
 
• Pronoun "her" is changed to "me" to match the direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Please" and ends with a period ".".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, with the speaker’s name.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“Please bring me a watch,” said my sister."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Please bring my sister a watch,” said she." 

 
 
• Incorrect as it suggests someone else is asking for the sister's watch, not the sister herself.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** “My sister, please bring me a watch.” said she." 
 
 
• Unnecessary addition of "My sister" which is not present in the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Will you bring me a watch?” said my sister.” 
 
 
• Changes the request into a question, altering the original meaning.
